categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main business segments: new display device inspection equipment and semiconductor memory device testing equipment. It provides specialized equipment and solutions for optical, electrical, and defect detection and repair in AMOLED, TFT-LCD, micro-display, and semiconductor memory manufacturing processes.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include algorithmic pattern generators (ALPG), DRAM repair algorithms, probe card design and assembly, high-precision timing signal generation, high-speed signal interconnection, uniform temperature control in aging chambers, specialized display signal driving and acquisition, AI-based defect detection platforms, and advanced optical measurement and compensation technologies. The company employs customized production based on customer orders, integrating hardware assembly, software installation, and system debugging with strict quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading manufacturers in new display devices and semiconductor memory sectors, including major panel makers like BOE, TCL, Visionox, and Tianma, as well as semiconductor memory companies such as Changxin Technology and Payton Technology. The products serve markets in consumer electronics, automotive displays, AR/VR micro-displays, and semiconductor memory testing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and production facilities in Shenzhen and subsidiaries in cities like Suzhou, Changsha, and Hefei. It currently has no overseas sales but plans to expand internationally. Its customer base is concentrated in various Chinese regions including South China, Central China, East China, North China, and Southwest China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, providing specialized testing and inspection equipment to downstream manufacturers of display panels and semiconductor memory devices. It also engages in upstream component development such as probe cards and key parts for testing machines.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on dual-driven development of new display device inspection and semiconductor memory testing equipment, emphasizing continuous technological innovation and increased R&D investment. Key R&D directions include AMOLED mid-size and micro-display testing, high-end DRAM testing and repair, MEMS probe card domestic substitution, and development of next-generation storage testing systems. The company also invests in talent development and strengthens internal controls and digital management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of equipment and accessories to downstream manufacturers, supplemented by maintenance and service contracts. The company follows a make-to-order production model and uses direct sales channels without intermediaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the new display device inspection equipment market, achieving over 90% domestic market share in AMOLED Cell/Module process equipment. In semiconductor memory testing, it is among the few domestic firms with full coverage of back-end testing equipment, competing against major international companies like Advantest and Teradyne, with growing recognition and market share in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 648.56 million, a 28.53% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 115.68 million, up 75.10%. Total assets reached RMB 1.996 billion, and net assets attributable to shareholders were RMB 1.719 billion, reflecting strong growth and financial stability. The company completed its IPO on the Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market in July 2023, significantly increasing capital.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-precision, technologically advanced inspection and testing solutions tailored to customer-specific manufacturing processes, enabling improved product yield and reduced production losses. Its competitive advantages include comprehensive product lines covering key process nodes, strong R&D capabilities, extensive production experience, localized technical support, and a robust domestic supply chain that supports cost-effective and reliable equipment with rapid service response.
